rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem

scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors
scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed a solid root cause analysis, correctly identifying the primary issue (HotReload files using .NET Core-only APIs compiled against net472), the cascade effect of FS0039 errors causing downstream FS0072/FS0008 errors, and separating genuine code bugs from the TFM compatibility issue. The investigation was mostly efficient, though some queries didn't filter as intended (both TFM filters returned 169). The final output is well-structured, actionable, and provides a clear fix recommendation. Minor inaccuracy in claiming errors are net472-only when evidence shows errors on both TFMs (100 on net10.0 vs 61 on net472), but the core insight about missing API guards is correct.
